name: Paper 3 - Regime A - HDPE/Bi2O3 phi=0.189 (68.6 wt%)
description: Regime-A (effective-medium) companion study for the cross-regime comparison. Material is the effective homogeneous composite corresponding to volume fraction phi=0.189: 68.6 wt% Bi2O3 / 31.4 wt% HDPE at rho=2.452 g/cm3 (self-consistent via linear mixture rule with rho_f=8.9, rho_m=0.95). This is the target material for the regime B (G4PVParameterised) and regime C (G4MultiUnion) RVE benchmarks. Validates that the effective-medium approximation matches the explicit-geometry RVE results.

paper3.notes: Cross-regime companion to regime_b_rve and regime_c_multiunion. Uses the same energy grid and same phi=0.189 effective composition as the RVE regimes.
